title: Infinite Soil / Quantum Tuber / Dark Sector — Developed Cosmological Theory
status: Great Book archaeology + developed dark-sector model family; no common physical Soil established
abstract: The Infinite Soil and Cosmic Soil chapters become scientifically strongest when treated as a family of explicit cosmological descendants rather than as a claim that dark matter and dark energy are literally one hidden substance. The historical imagery separates naturally into three mathematical questions: whether a field can support localized excitations, whether an unseen clustering component can explain gravitational structure, and whether a smooth negative-pressure component can explain accelerated expansion. This redevelopment builds the latter two into a common dynamical framework. It starts from Lambda-CDM as the null model, then defines canonical scalar dark energy, interacting dark-sector and unified-dark-fluid branches using background continuity equations, perturbation/sound-speed requirements, stability tests and a ratio dynamical system. A worked interaction Q=xi H rho_c reveals an important negative result: the simplest positive fixed point that might appear to solve the coincidence problem is unstable for the usual w<0, xi>0 parameter choice. That failure is scientifically valuable because it forces a richer coupling or abandons the unification claim. The theory therefore progresses by asking whether a single Soil descendant can reproduce both expansion and clustering while making a preregistered prediction in growth or lensing beyond Lambda-CDM. The branch is T2 as a cosmological model-selection programme and T0-T1 as a uniquely Potato physical sector.
research_question: Can one explicit Soil-inspired action or interacting-fluid model reproduce both the background expansion and perturbation growth of the observed universe while yielding a stable, identifiable prediction that is not absorbed by Lambda-CDM or simpler dark-sector alternatives?
historical_core: Infinite Soil as field/vacuum substrate analogy.
Quantum Tuber as localized activation or ripple.
Cosmic Soil as hidden structure plus expansive/fertile aspect.

baseline_lambda_cdm.continuity: rho_dot+3H(rho+p)=0 for each separately conserved perfect-fluid component
baseline_lambda_cdm.growth: delta_m_ddot+2H delta_m_dot-4piG rho_m delta_m=0 in the standard subhorizon linear approximation
baseline_lambda_cdm.role: every Soil descendant must first match this baseline where it is already successful

A_container_only.meaning: Soil is a semantic container for separately typed dark matter and dark energy.
A_container_only.value: preserves historical structure without inventing a common substance

B_scalar_DE_plus_DM.meaning: the expansive Soil aspect is modeled as a dynamical scalar while dark matter remains separate

C_interacting_dark_sector.requirement: Q must be specified phenomenologically or derived from an action; total energy-momentum is conserved
C_interacting_dark_sector.meaning: the two hidden sectors can exchange energy while remaining dynamically distinct

D_unified_fluid.equation: T_mu_nu=(rho+p)u_mu u_nu+p g_mu_nu with p=p(rho) or a specified field action
D_unified_fluid.requirement: must cluster approximately like matter where needed yet produce negative effective pressure cosmologically
D_unified_fluid.critical_quantity: effective/rest-frame sound speed determines whether perturbations remain compatible with structure formation

ratio_dynamics.negative_result: For w<0, a physically positive r* in this simple convention requires xi>0, which gives f'(r*)>0 and hence an unstable nonzero fixed point.
ratio_dynamics.meaning: the simplest one-parameter coupling does not automatically solve the coincidence problem; a more elaborate interaction must earn its complexity

perturbation_contract.why_background_is_insufficient: many dark-energy/interacting models reproduce H(z) while differing strongly in growth and lensing
perturbation_contract.stability: exclude ghost, gradient and uncontrolled tachyonic instabilities over the fitted regime
perturbation_contract.observable_link: derive P(k), f sigma_8, weak-lensing and CMB-lensing consequences from the same model

field_unification_option.goal: one field has a background equation of state that can interpolate between matter-like and dark-energy-like behavior
field_unification_option.challenge: the perturbations must simultaneously cluster sufficiently at the relevant epoch/scales without producing excessive pressure support or oscillations
field_unification_option.test: derive both background and perturbation equations; background interpolation alone is not a unification

model_inference.parameters: theta includes cosmological baseline parameters plus Soil-specific masses, potential/coupling parameters or equation-of-state coefficients
model_inference.degeneracies: report correlations with H0, neutrino mass, galaxy bias, sigma8 and nuisance/systematic parameters where relevant
model_inference.principle: a good fit is not enough if the new parameters are unidentifiable

interacting_sector: scale/redshift dependence in growth depending on coupling prescription
unified_fluid: specific relation between background equation of state and perturbation sound speed/structure growth
distinctive_predictions.rule: choose at least one prediction before tuning the model to the target dataset

cosmic_web_root_test.translation: compare cosmic-web and neural/root-like structures through separately constructed graphs or topological skeletons
cosmic_web_root_test.null: generic spatial/network models matched for density and sampling
cosmic_web_root_test.promotion_gate: claim a shared law only if one generative model predicts both descriptor distributions better than appropriate nulls

failure_conditions: The physical Soil descendant cannot fit expansion and growth/lensing simultaneously.
The fitted region contains ghost/gradient instability or unacceptable sound speed behavior without a justified EFT cutoff.
Soil-specific parameters are non-identifiable and add no predictive improvement.
The common-field branch cannot behave matter-like enough for clustering and dark-energy-like enough for acceleration in the same viable model.
The apparent coincidence solution relies on an unstable fixed point or severe fine tuning.
Cross-scale root similarity disappears against matched geometric/network null models.
next_decisive_calculations: Choose one explicit interacting model beyond the simple unstable Q=xi H rho_c example, or retain Soil as a container.
Derive background fixed points and their stability analytically before fitting data.
Derive linear perturbation equations and sound-speed/stability conditions.
Fit expansion and growth/lensing jointly against Lambda-CDM.
Predeclare one growth or lensing signature that would promote the model beyond metaphor.
